notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Omen Hawker.
Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.
